Predict simulator output from a fitted emulator

Source: R/func_wrapper.R
emulator_predict.Rd

With an ordinary emulator_learn() result, supply either new design matrices or saved simulator outputs used to construct them. With a calibration_prepare() result, the offline GP supplies those rows and dt_pde_test is unnecessary.

Usage

emulator_predict(
  emulator,
  input_new,
  dt_pde_test = NULL,
  F_new_ls = "default",
  MC = FALSE
)

Arguments

emulator

An emulator or prepared calibration-input object.

input_new

Matrix or vector of new mechanistic parameter inputs.

dt_pde_test

Optional saved responses at new inputs, used only to construct default AR designs for an ordinary emulator.

F_new_ls

"default" or explicit episode design matrices.

MC

If TRUE, return coefficient-conditioned mean samples, not full draws of the emulator field. If FALSE, return smoothed means for an ordinary emulator, or draw-averaged means for a prepared emulator.

Value

A time-indexed list of matrices, or arrays with a final posterior draw dimension when MC = TRUE.

See also

FFBS_predict_exact(), calibration_predict()

Examples

data("dt_emulation")
d <- dt_emulation
em <- emulator_learn(d$pde_para_train, d$dt_pde_train, Nx = 10, Ny = 10,
                     nsam = 5, seed = 1)
pred <- emulator_predict(em, d$pde_para_test, dt_pde_test = d$dt_pde_test)
dim(pred[[2]])
#> [1]  10 100
sqrt(mean((unlist(pred) - unlist(d$dt_pde_test))^2))
#> [1] 0.1241679
